question:
Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-cloud $.identity_cost.kind: Page shows a phone number used for SMS verification and a username for login, but names no country restriction; country-phone is not stated (claim c04 itself says the foreign-number path is unverified).
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-cloud $.egress.terms: Quote 下载不限速度，不限流量，不限次数，免登录下载 is on the page, but the capture has no ad-funded statement and no FAQ sentence 我们对下载速度不做任何限制 (it says 对下载不做任何限制); fresh read gave the identical capture hash.
- netdisk-pan/playstation-plus-cloud-storage $.limits[1].value: Page supports the PS Plus membership requirement and console UI upload steps, but does not say uploads need a PSN-authenticated console in those words.
- netdisk-pan/nintendo-switch-online-save-data-cloud $.limits[1].value: Page supports the NSO subscription requirement but nowhere states that the console is the only client.
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-premium $.per_object_cap.stated: Quote is a third-party storage-capacity row (10GB, 2T for one year, 10TB); it says nothing about a per-object cap, a 100 MB legacy limit or account-gated large-file resolution.
- netdisk-pan/naver-mybox $.free_tier.stated: Table row with 80GB, 180GB and 330GB columns is on the page, but the page does not state '国内 최대 무료 용량 30GB'; the 30GB column is a plan column, not labelled free. Fresh read gave the identical capture hash.
- netdisk-pan/quixicloud $.identity_cost.kind: Quote says 10GB instantly and no credit card required, but neither quixicloud.in nor quixicloud.com capture names an email requirement for signup.
- netdisk-pan/naver-mybox $.free_tier.stated: Table showing 50,000回/日 on every plan column is on the page, but the page does not state '30 GB free' or '국내 최대 무료 용량 30GB'. A claim is the field's whole value, and the auditor must find one span in your capture that says it. For every field named in a confirm's paths, the value must be exactly what that one quote proves. When a field's value is a synthesis of several facts, do one of these: capture a page that states all of it and quote that; or narrow the field's value to the fact your quote proves and move each other fact to its own field or limits row with its own evidence; or leave the field out of every confirm and list it in unread. Never name a field whose value goes beyond its quote.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-premium $.egress.terms: Source says ordinary users download files under 100M without login and VIP has no size limit; it does not say larger files need a login.
- netdisk-pan/quixicloud $.retention.stated: Capture says primary storage data is permanently deleted at Day 60 (after expiry), so a retention clock is published; value says none is.
- netdisk-pan/pan-moe $.limits[0].value: Source forbids multiple accounts for expansion (5.4), but says the provider has the right to deal with them (有权...处置，包括但不限于停用、封禁), not that it closes them.
- netdisk-pan/nintendo-switch-online-save-data-cloud $.per_object_cap.stated: Source proves one save file per title per Nintendo Account only; 'no aggregate cap' and 'no way to store non-save bytes' are not stated.
- netdisk-pan/naver-mybox $.free_tier.stated: Source proves 30GB free only; the MYBOX+ add-on sizes (50 GB to 20 TB) are not on this page.
- netdisk-pan/naver-mybox $.identity_cost.detail: Source says signup needs a mobile phone that need not be in the user's name, i.e. no real-name check; value says Korean real-name verification and forum reports, neither in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/nintendo-switch-online-save-data-cloud $.free_tier.stated: Source proves one save file per title per account; family plan covering eight accounts and personal covering one are not stated in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/playstation-plus-cloud-storage $.free_tier.stated: Table only lists '100GB Cloud Storage' in all three plans; the capture says '100 GB of online storage for PS5 consoles and PS4 consoles', which does not state separate 100+100 or 200 GB total. 1000 PS4 file limit is stated, subscription requirement is implied by plan table.
- netdisk-pan/pan-moe $.free_tier.stated: Landing page proves 1TB free permanent and up to 5TB for community members; 2-5 TB by application, cold-storage plan above 5 TB and terms 3.1 are not in this capture.
- netdisk-pan/naver-mybox $.identity_cost.kind: Source says signup requires a mobile phone, not necessarily in the user's name; nothing about a national ID.
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-premium $.egress.terms: Speed-limit part is supported, but 'larger files need a login unless the downloader is VIP' is not stated in the capture.
